title: 2008 HMMT February Guts Problem 10
statement: Find the number of subsets \(S\) of \(\{1,2, \ldots 63\}\) the sum of whose elements is 2008 .

solutions.text: 6 Note that \(1+2+\cdots+63=2016\). So the problem is equivalent to finding the number of subsets of \(\{1,2, \cdots 63\}\) whose sum of elements is 8 . We can count this by hand: \(\{8\},\{1,7\},\{2,6\}\), \(\{3,5\},\{1,2,5\},\{1,3,4\}\).
